prompt.text: A client needs the drawings tonight. The share window is set to anyone with the link. The send button is already highlighted.

choices.label: Send the anyone-link
choices.debrief: Anyone who is forwarded that link can open the drawings.
choices.report: The drawings went out on a link with no names on it.
choices.voice_line: You sent a link that works for anyone who receives it.

fallout.text: The link shows up in a thread you are not on. The drawings have been downloaded twice.

choices.label: Add the client's work addresses, then send
choices.debrief: Named people can be removed. An open link cannot.
choices.report: The drawings were shared with named work addresses only.
choices.voice_line: You sent it only to the client's work addresses.

choices.label: Send it to the client's personal mail instead
choices.debrief: A personal mailbox is outside the company, and outside theirs.
choices.bark: You sent it to personal mail.
choices.report: The drawings went to a personal address.
choices.voice_line: You sent the drawings to a personal mailbox.

fallout.text: That personal mailbox is compromised. The drawings are in a dump with the rest of it.

draft_note: Right choice is named access, not a looser channel.
